thn_vulns.title: Lazarus Group Exploits Windows Zero-Day
thn_vulns.description: The North Korean threat actor Lazarus Group has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a newly patched security flaw impacting Microsoft Windows AFD.sys driver.

thn_vulns.title: Hackers Compromised 14,500 Dahua Cameras
thn_vulns.description: Researchers disclosed a campaign that compromised more than 14,530 Dahua devices using credential attacks and two authentication-bypass flaws.

thn_vulns.title: China-Nexus Actor Exploits VMware vCenter
thn_vulns.description: A suspected China-nexus APT exploited a newly patched critical security flaw in Broadcom VMware vCenter Server.

thn_vulns.title: Critical Fortinet FortiGate RCE Vulnerability
thn_vulns.description: Fortinet disclosed a critical remote code execution vulnerability affecting FortiGate firewalls running FortiOS.

thn_vulns.title: Apache Struts RCE Vulnerability Active Exploitation
thn_vulns.description: Attackers are actively exploiting a critical RCE vulnerability in Apache Struts 2 framework.

thn_vulns.title: Microsoft Exchange Server Zero-Day Patched
thn_vulns.description: Microsoft patched an actively exploited zero-day in Exchange Server allowing authenticated RCE.

thn_vulns.title: GitLab Critical Path Traversal Vulnerability
thn_vulns.description: GitLab disclosed a critical path traversal flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files.

thn_vulns.title: Cisco Catalyst Switches DNS Spoofing Bug
thn_vulns.description: A vulnerability in Cisco Catalyst switches allows DNS spoofing on the management interface.

thn_vulns.title: Selenium Grid Exploited to Mine Cryptocurrency
thn_vulns.description: Attackers are exploiting exposed Selenium Grid instances to deploy cryptocurrency miners.

thn_vulns.title: Chrome V8 Type Confusion Bug Under Active Exploitation
thn_vulns.description: Google patched a critical type confusion vulnerability in Chrome V8 engine that is being actively exploited in the wild.

fortinet_psirt.title: FG-IR-26-001: FortiOS Buffer Overflow
fortinet_psirt.description: A buffer overflow in FortiOS SSL VPN may allow remote code execution.

fortinet_psirt.title: FG-IR-26-002: FortiManager Authentication Bypass
fortinet_psirt.description: An authentication bypass in FortiManager may allow unauthenticated access.

fortinet_psirt.title: FG-IR-26-003: FortiProxy Denial of Service
fortinet_psirt.description: A denial of service vulnerability in FortiProxy web proxy.
